about_the_game:
Experience the ultimate drift racing sensation in Drift Legends 2, the second installment of the incredibly realistic 3D drifting game. Take control of highly-detailed legendary drift cars and conquer various tracks as you strive to break records. Test your skills in a multiplayer game mode, if you think you are tough enough. Challenge other drivers and ascend to the pinnacle of the online leaderboard. Progress from a novice to a professional drift driver.

FEATURES:

- Realistic physics, simulating every aspect of car behavior;
- Drive more than 50 powerful and exciting, highly detailed drifting cars;
- Drift on detailed tracks with different layouts;
- Career mode allows you to get more experience, complete achievements and unlock powerful secret cars;
- Every car behaves differently. Feel the power and weight, find your balance;
- Customize your cars with exclusive paintjobs, rims, tires and plates;
- Real engine sounds for every car;
- Turbocharger, gearbox and tires sounds;
- Realistic 3D graphics;
- Online drift multiplayer.

If you're a car enthusiast, this game is definitely for you!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel® 4590 or AMD Ryzen3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® 11 compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: The application’s stability is not guaranteed on Intel HD Graphics and AMD HD Radeon on-board graphics cards.
